text:
Boscán, the arms and fury of Mars,
        which, watering African soil with its own blood,
        make the Roman empire
        flourish again in this land,


        have brought back to memory the skill
        and ancient valor of Italy,
        by whose might and valiant hand
        Africa trembled from end to end.


        Here, where the Roman blaze,
        where fire and its unbridled flame
        left Carthage only its name,


        love turns and turns my thoughts,
        wounds and kindles my fearful soul,
        and I dissolve in tears and ashes.

translation.title: Boscán, the arms and fury of Mars
translation.editorial_note: Imported as a translation without separate editorial review.
